title: Lifting a unimodular residue row to SL₂(ℤ)
statement: For every nonzero natural number N and r,s in ℤ/Nℤ, if there exist x,y in ℤ/Nℤ with xr+ys=1, then there is A in SL₂(ℤ) whose bottom-left and bottom-right entries reduce to r and s, respectively.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (r s : ZMod N), (∃ x y : ZMod N, x * r + y * s = 1) → ∃ A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, (A 1 0 : ZMod N) = r ∧ (A 1 1 : ZMod N) = s
